Week 7 · heavy favorites on a streak

BoardParlayGames↻
This page ranks legs by how often they've cleared today's line, not by value. Heavy favorites that keep hitting are the raw material; the slip at the bottom shows what they're really worth once multiplied. A 90% leg five times over is a 59% parlay. Legs where the market and model disagree sharply are hidden by default: a backup who was under 35 yards ten times straight stops being a lock the week he becomes the starter.
